title: WitnessPayloadV1
description: The JSON a trooth.witness-statement.v1 payload holds. v1 binds the outcomes and counts only: no mapping, manifest, evaluator or subject scope.

reading_id.description: The id of the reading. Also usable as trooth:reading:<reading_id> (docs/IDS.md).

domain.description: The domain the reading was taken of: lowercase, no trailing dot.

read_at.description: When Trooth took the reading, as Trooth asserts it when signing. There is no independent timestamp. An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, as written by Trooth (for example 2026-10-06T20:00:44.820Z).

counts.description: The two counts, which must agree with the checks.

CheckV1.title: CheckV1
CheckV1.description: One check in a v1 reading. v1 carries no reason.

CountsV1.title: CountsV1
CountsV1.description: The two counts a v1 payload carries.

read.description: Checks whose outcome is not `not read`.
